user.title: AlarmGrid
user.description: Set up the DCS-style alarm annunciator.

init.title: AlarmGrid options
init.description: These settings are also available, with explanations, in the AlarmGrid panel under Settings. Saving reloads AlarmGrid.

data_description.media_players: Players that receive the alarm sound when media player output is enabled.
data_description.repeat_interval_seconds: How often the horn repeats while alarms are unacknowledged.
data_description.repeat_until_silenced: Repeat at the interval below. When off, play once per new alarm.

data_description.alarm_flood_threshold: Number of new alarms that counts as an alarm flood.
data_description.alarm_flood_window_seconds: Time window in which the flood threshold is counted.
data_description.auto_shelve_flapping_alarms: Shelve an alarm automatically when it keeps toggling.
data_description.flapping_detection_threshold: Activations within 5 minutes before an alarm is considered flapping.

data_description.telegram_targets: Telegram notify entities that receive the messages.
data_description.telegram_min_priority: Alarms below this priority are not sent.

data_description.telegram_callback_event_entities: Event entities that receive Telegram button presses.

data_description.panel_title: Title in the sidebar and inside the panel. Refresh the page after saving.
data_description.create_rule_buttons: Acknowledge, shelve and disable buttons for every rule. Turning this off removes existing per-rule buttons; global buttons remain.

data_description.history_retention_days: Deletes older events at startup and every hour. Existing history older than this limit is deleted too.
data_description.max_history_rows: Limits the panel history query; does not delete events or limit exports.
data_description.store_status_changes: Record source changes without an alarm lifecycle transition. Alarm transitions and operator actions are always recorded.
data_description.store_normal_events: Also record source changes while the alarm remains normal. Requires source change recording.

rule_defaults.name: Rule defaults and clearing
rule_defaults.description: Defaults for new rules and clear behaviour

data_description.default_delay_on_seconds: Initial value for new rules only. Existing rules and explicit values are preserved.
data_description.default_delay_off_seconds: Initial value for new rules only.
data_description.default_deadband: Initial value for new numeric rules; in the source measurement unit.
data_description.require_acknowledgement_for_cleared: When off, future clears are acknowledged automatically. Per-rule auto-ack still takes precedence when enabled.

data_description.max_active_alarms: Panel display limit only: every alarm is still monitored and counted.
data_description.auto_hide_cleared_acknowledged: Hide these rows from the panel active view; history is retained.
data_description.show_cleared_unacknowledged: Include these rows in the panel active and unacknowledged views.
data_description.default_tab: Used when opening a new panel session.
data_description.enable_flashing: Applies to the panel and cards. Individual card flashing preferences still apply.
data_description.enable_compact_mode: Reduce vertical spacing in the alarm table.
data_description.group_by: Group the displayed rows by area, system or priority.

error.telegram_targets_required: Select at least one Telegram notify entity.
error.telegram_callback_entities_required: Select at least one Telegram callback event entity.
error.telegram_action_required: Allow at least one interactive action.
error.invalid_number: Enter a valid number (whole numbers where required).
error.invalid_entity: An entity of the wrong type was selected.
